blocks.corrected_text: Like ammonia, nitrogen atom of amines is trivalent and carries an unshared pair of electrons.  Nitrogen orbitals in amines are therefore, sp³ hybridised and the geometry of amines is pyramidal. Each of  the three sp³ hybridised orbitals of nitrogen overlap with orbitals of hydrogen or carbon depending upon the composition of the amines.
